title: Readback intent v0.1
description: What a signer said they are about to sign, recorded faithfully. Never what the transaction does.

amount.description: The number the signer said, as a plain number: "a hundred" is 100, "half" is 0.5, "two thousand five hundred" is 2500. For swaps and buys, the amount being PAID. For change_threshold, the new number of signatures. Null if no number was said.

token.description: The asset the signer is PAYING or SENDING, as a ticker or name ("usdc", "eth", "dollars"). For "buy X with Y", this is Y. Null if not said.

token_out.description: For swaps, buys and sells, the asset the signer wants to RECEIVE. For "buy X with Y", this is X. Null otherwise.

recipient.description: Who receives the funds, who is being approved to spend them, or for Safe administration the owner, module or guard involved. In the signer's words, or a 0x address if one was read out. "me" for themselves. Null if not said.

confirm.description: True only when the signer is plainly confirming, not describing a transaction.
